name: Home Assistant
short_desc: External: connect the Home Assistant you already run at home, and your Wizard checks and controls your devices.
author: Humanity Labs (connector for Home Assistant)
description: Connects your Wizard to the Home Assistant you already run (Raspberry Pi, Home Assistant Green or any other install). Paste its address and a long-lived access token once (Home Assistant: Profile, Security, Create token); they stay in this app's private storage and are never shown again. Your agent then checks and controls every device Home Assistant knows about, including Zigbee, Bluetooth and other local-only devices. Unlocking doors or disarming alarms always needs your yes. Your Wizard must be able to reach Home Assistant: on the same network, through Tailscale, or through Home Assistant Cloud. No Home Assistant? Install Smart Home instead. Keep it on your private network.
